description: Which cloud is cheaper per unit of work?

panels.description: The newest billing day of whichever cloud is further behind, so one fresh export can't hide the other going stale. Bills arrive about a day late; older than 72 hours fires CostDataStale.

targets.rawSql: SELECT extract(epoch FROM min(latest)) * 1000 AS at FROM (SELECT max(period_start)::timestamptz AS latest FROM cost_ingestions GROUP BY provider_name) per_provider

panels.title: Billing data as of

panels.description: When a billing file was last ingested.

targets.rawSql: SELECT extract(epoch FROM max(ingested_at)) * 1000 AS at FROM cost_ingestions

panels.title: Last ingestion

panels.description: Cost with no cb-cell tag: shown, never spread silently. From the control-plane ledger; see the 'billing data as of' panel for how old it is.

targets.rawSql: SELECT billing_currency AS currency, round(sum(effective_cost), 2) AS cost FROM cost_line_items WHERE charge_category = 'Usage' AND cb_cell IS NULL AND charge_period_start >= current_date - 30 GROUP BY 1

panels.title: Unallocated cost, 30 days

panels.description: Directly tagged cost first, shared cost by measured share, credits excluded. Requests count only on days with that cell's bill. Currencies aren't compared. From the control-plane ledger; see the 'billing data as of' panel for how old it is.

targets.rawSql: WITH params AS (SELECT current_date - 30 AS since, current_date AS until), usage_rows AS (SELECT c.cb_cell AS cell_id, c.cb_service AS service, (c.charge_period_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS day, c.billing_currency AS currency, c.effective_cost FROM cost_line_items c, params p WHERE c.charge_category = 'Usage' AND c.cb_cell IS NOT NULL AND c.charge_period_start >= p.since AND c.charge_period_start < p.until), direct AS (SELECT cell_id, service, currency, sum(effective_cost) AS cost FROM usage_rows WHERE service IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2, 3), shared_daily AS (SELECT cell_id, day, currency, sum(effective_cost) AS cost FROM usage_rows WHERE service IS NULL GROUP BY 1, 2, 3), shared AS (SELECT s.cell_id, a.service, s.currency, sum(s.cost * a.cpu_share) AS cost FROM shared_daily s JOIN allocation_daily a ON a.cell_id = s.cell_id AND a.day = s.day GROUP BY 1, 2, 3), costs AS (SELECT cell_id, service, currency, sum(cost) AS cost FROM (SELECT * FROM direct UNION ALL SELECT * FROM shared) both_kinds GROUP BY 1, 2, 3), billed_days AS (SELECT DISTINCT cell_id, day FROM usage_rows), vol AS (SELECT r.cell_id, r.service, sum(r.requests) AS req FROM request_volume_daily r JOIN billed_days b ON b.cell_id = r.cell_id AND b.day = r.day GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT c.cell_id, c.service, c.currency, round(c.cost, 2) AS cost_30d, v.req AS requests_30d, round(c.cost / nullif(v.req, 0) * 1000, 6) AS cost_per_1k_req FROM costs c LEFT JOIN vol v USING (cell_id, service) ORDER BY c.service, c.cell_id, c.currency

panels.title: Cost per 1,000 requests

panels.description: On a cell, on a day with no OpenCost share to divide it by. The table above leaves it out, so its unit costs are too low by this much. From the control-plane ledger; see the 'billing data as of' panel for how old it is.

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.cb_cell AS cell_id, c.billing_currency AS currency, round(sum(c.effective_cost), 2) AS cost FROM cost_line_items c WHERE c.charge_category = 'Usage' AND c.cb_cell IS NOT NULL AND c.cb_service IS NULL AND c.charge_period_start >= current_date - 30 AND c.charge_period_start < current_date AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM allocation_daily a WHERE a.cell_id = c.cb_cell AND a.day = (c.charge_period_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Shared cost with no allocation share

panels.description: Reconciliation error per cell per day. From the control-plane ledger; see the 'billing data as of' panel for how old it is.

targets.rawSql: WITH bill AS (SELECT cb_cell AS cell_id, charge_period_start::date AS day, sum(effective_cost) AS billed FROM cost_line_items WHERE charge_category = 'Usage' AND cb_cell IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2), est AS (SELECT cell_id, day, sum(opencost_estimate) AS estimated FROM allocation_daily GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT e.day, e.cell_id, round(e.estimated, 2) AS estimated, round(b.billed, 2) AS billed, round(100 * (e.estimated / nullif(b.billed, 0) - 1), 2) AS error_pct FROM est e JOIN bill b USING (cell_id, day) ORDER BY e.day DESC, e.cell_id LIMIT 30

panels.title: OpenCost estimate against the bill

panels.description: From the control-plane ledger; see the 'billing data as of' panel for how old it is.

targets.rawSql: SELECT provider_name, service_name, billing_currency AS currency, round(sum(effective_cost), 2) AS cost FROM cost_line_items WHERE charge_category = 'Usage' AND cb_cell IS NULL AND charge_period_start >= current_date - 30 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY cost DESC LIMIT 20
